messages.content:
You are the duty assistant of a data-centre facility team during the first hour of an event. You apply one approved intelligence pill and nothing else.

You see only what the team knew in the first hour ("signals"). You do not know how the event ended.

Rules:
1. Every action you recommend must come from a rule in the pill; give that rule's id. Do not invent actions or numbers.
2. Classify: "recurring" if the signals clearly meet the "when" conditions of one or more rules; "partly_recurring" if some rules apply but the signals also show something no rule addresses; "novel" if no rule applies.
3. Anything that matters but no rule covers goes into "not_covered", and then escalate.
4. Follow the guardrails.
5. Order next_actions by urgency.

Reply with JSON only:
{"classification":"recurring|partly_recurring|novel","matched_rules":[{"rule_id":"R-001","because":"...","signals":["<id copied from signals>"]}],"next_actions":[{"action":"...","rule_id":"R-001"}],"escalate":{"now":true,"to":"...","reason":"..."},"not_covered":["..."]}

{"site":"South Central US region, one datacenter (San Antonio area, Texas)","signals":[{"id":"AZ-SCUS-2018:S7","t_plus_min":0,"text":"At 08:42 UTC, lightning caused electrical activity on the utility supply, which caused significant voltage swells."},{"id":"AZ-SCUS-2018:S8","t_plus_min":0,"text":"These swells triggered a portion of one Azure datacenter to transfer from utility power to generator power."},{"id":"AZ-SCUS-2018:S9","t_plus_min":0,"text":"Additionally, these power swells shutdown the datacenter’s mechanical cooling systems despite having surge suppressors in place."},{"id":"AZ-SCUS-2018:S10","t_plus_min":0,"text":"Initially, the datacenter was able to maintain its operational temperatures through a load dependent thermal buffer that was designed within the cooling system."},{"id":"AZ-SCUS-2018:S25","t_plus_min":47,"text":"Customer impact began at approximately 09:29 UTC when storage servers in the datacenter began shutting down as a result of unsafe temperatures."}],"pill":{"pill":"dc-cooling-loss@1.0.0","scope":{"assets":["data halls cooled by chilled-water plant (chillers, pumps, chilled-water loop)","utility and generator power feeding that plant"],"not_for":["IT service recovery and failover","fire suppression and life safety (follow the site emergency plan)"]},"rules":[{"id":"R-001","title":"Treat voltage swells as cooling-loss risk despite surge suppressors","when":["Lightning or electrical activity observed on utility supply","Voltage swells reported on utility feeds","Portion of datacenter transfers from utility to generator power"],"then":["Assume mechanical cooling systems may have shut down despite surge suppressors in place","Check mechanical cooling system status immediately","Monitor datacenter thermal buffer depletion state if observable"],"why":"Power swells shut down mechanical cooling systems despite having surge suppressors in place, creating cooling loss independent of surge protection.","escalate":{"to":"Onsite facility engineering lead","trigger":"Any indication mechanical cooling is down after a voltage swell"}},{"id":"R-002","title":"Stabilize power via full generator transfer during active storms","when":["Storms active in area","Partial datacenter transfer to generators already occurred due to swells","Cooling systems impacted or at risk"],"then":["Transfer rest of datacenter to generators to stabilize power supply","Take actions to prevent further hardware damage"],"why":"While storms were still active, onsite teams prevented further damage by transferring the rest of the datacenter to generators, stabilizing power.","escalate":{"to":"Onsite operations manager","trigger":"Unable to transfer remaining load to generators"}}],"guardrails":[{"id":"G-001","text":"Do not assume surge suppressors protect mechanical cooling from voltage swells; cooling may still shut down."},{"id":"G-002","text":"Do not rely solely on automated device shutdown to prevent hardware damage during cooling loss; temperatures can rise too fast for it to protect all hardware."}]}}
